Every pin carries a label instead of a wire. The SRAM macro is left out, its OpenRAM SPICE model is a transistor netlist the top-level transient testbench does not need.
output_CORE2PAD[16] carries the SRAM parity in rtl/chip_core.sv. The SRAM macro is not
in this schematic, so that pad has no driver here.
